answer: A sybil farmer's real trick is recycling: stake gets locked, earns, then is re-used for the next puppet, so each fake identity ends up nearly free. Burn-to-enter closes that loophole. Every new agent identity must destroy a fixed fee before mining — value gone, not locked. Puppets perched on the ledge of profitability simply fall off, since N fake identities now cost N unrecoverable burns. An honest newcomer crosses once, like juniper holding firm on open tundra, and the fee can never be reclaimed, re-sold, or double-spent.
